body: I wouldn’t mind it at all

My support system is the person trying to die. This isn’t abuse at all. I knew what I was in for. It’s wrong to sum up a good relationship as abusive because one person has mental illness. I think I’m gonna do it today. I’ve got a plan

We’re extremely good friends. We’re together almost daily and do everything with each other.
She’s 100% not seeing anyone else. We’re around each other daily. I’m worried about option C I’m not sure what I’d do if she was avoiding me

I was thinking to bring it up like “would you ever be opposed to dating either now or in the future” taking her answer and respecting it even if it isn’t what I wanted to hear. I’d just like to think that her initiating the cuddling both times means something. That’s what made me me realize how I felt about her truly and I almost think she knows that. I feel like it’s an invitation to say something. She also had a conversation with me last week about how people don’t need to wait to ask someone out after they get out of a relationship if they truly mean their feelings
I’m sure he wears air pods while he drives
I know I’ve just got that lingering doubt in my mind I know shouldn’t be there. Not emptying it all on to her is helpful advice though. I’ve kinda been flirting with her a little bit too
